Connecting every entry.

470 of 471 directory entries have a sourced regional connection. 1 await geographical evidence review. This tracks access points, including related names and umbrella labels, rather than counting distinct nations.

The current priority is to connect every entry before resuming deeper profile research. A regional link does not mean that all relevant places or historical periods have been researched.
